# ctslasse-pond reference: part 8 of the intro without its logo, logged from the ctslasse port (exact
# against the original under rea/ctslasse-analisis) with one print added after each frame, and the
# part's texture replaced by the marble the precalculation makes before embossing the logo in it

# frame N CLOCK SCREEN DAC GRID: the clock read (PIT ticks since the part began), CRC32 of the 320x200
# screen, of the DAC (768 bytes) and of the grid (31F8h bytes).
